LATE LAST week, India nominated the globally acclaimed Homebound, which lists legendary American filmmaker Martin Scorsese as an executive producer, as its official entry for Oscars 2026. Behind the curtains, the announcement marked another twist in the movie's turbulent journey within its own country - marred by aseries of cuts that appeared to rattle the film's makers so much they omitted Scorsese's name from the first set of posters before restoring it
